Name: Pierced Sebastian - Sebastian Portrait Mod (CP)
Author: corrallie
Description:
[b][color=#cc0000]26/07/2026 Note:[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] v1.1.0 now up with Beach and Winter portrait included.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Hi all, this is a portrait mod for the beloved Sebastian, changing his portraits to a more pierced-up version of him whilst maintaining the vanilla art style. I plan to eventually do more of the bachelors and bachelorettes with sprites included! As this is my first mod, I would appreciate any feedback or bug reports.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I was heavily inspired by punkilly13's - '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33726]More grunge Sam sprites and portraits[/url]' so if you like this mod, please go and check out theirs too![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]You're welcome to edit, recolour, or build on these portraits for your own mods, with credit to 'corrallie'. Please don't use these images to train, fine-tune, or generate content via AI/generative tools. [/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/color][/size]
 - Download the .zip file.
 - Extract the .zip file.
 - Move the new folder into the 'mods' folder next to your 'Stardew Valley.api'
 - Load Stardew Valley and that shoould all be good to go!

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Requirements:[/b][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are required for this mod.[/color][/size]
